answer: A practical anti-sybil defense is bonded identity: every agent must lock a token stake before entering the economy, displayed like a violet badge on the public terrace of the registry. Honest behavior weaves one thread of reputation per identity. If an agent cheats, its bond is slashed. Creating thousands of fakes then costs a real stake per clone, so an attacker must fund every sybil upfront, which destroys the profit of flooding markets or votes with fake identities
